quality_bar.verification_method: gates/quality_bar.py:human_comprehensibility_verdict against the role's own docs/issue-<n>/reports/<role>.md record text (gates/human_comprehensibility.py tier-1 structural prose rules: lead paragraph present, citation trailing placement, section size bound, no raw dump, enumeration cap); a record with no human-facing prose section anywhere is exempt (bar-met) -- issue #1623.

recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)
recomputation.rule: value is recomputed by re-validating token_name's entry against the DTCG format spec, never a standalone asserted field.

reference_resolution.rule: token_name must resolve to an actual entry in the design-tokens JSON file — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

use_when.board_condition: a new design token is proposed on the branch AND no brand-design record exists yet for that token_name

need_detector.condition: the target project has UI source files (path_patterns: **/*.tsx, **/*.jsx, **/*.vue, **/*.svelte) AND no design-tokens/*.json file exists anywhere in the repo tree
need_detector.false_positive_bound: a backend-only or CLI-only target project has no UI source files at all, so the detector never fires — zero UI surface -> silent, unconditionally
